name: Concrete Class
description: The contrary to ``abstract`` is concrete. PHP has abstract classes and methods. This is the default state of a method or class, when it has a code block with implementation. It also has no specific keyword to designate it.
code:
<?php

    abstract class AbstractClass
    {
        // Concrete method
        public function printOut() {
            print $this->getValue() . "\n";
        }
    
        // Method without an implementation
        abstract protected function getValue();
    }

?>
